tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phrin las bskul tshig re smon lhun grub bzhugs so// kyai/ pho lha gnam the dkar po 'khor bcas rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i mtha' klas par/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /dang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lo dgyes par rol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgo dam tshig dang / /las dang smon lam dbang gis 'brel ba ltar/ /jing gir rigs brgyud g.yog 'khor bcas pa dang / /rgya ma khri khang yul 'khor longs spyod la/ /nyin mtshan bsrung skyob bya ra mel tshe mdzod/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang / /phun tshogs dpal 'byor ma lus rgyas pa dang / /'dod dgu ma lus dbang du 'du ba dang / /dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /pho lha gnyen po 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /hor brgyud 'khor dang bcas la rjes brtse ltar/ /'phral dang yun gyi phan bde ma lus pa/ /myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las dus la babs/ /g.yab tshe gsal ba'i spyan ni ma yengs shig /bos tshe gsang ba'i snyan ni ma ring zhig /bsten tshe ko long phrag dog ma mdzad cig /rbad tshe mthu dang nus pa ma chung zhig /gnas 'dir char chu phebs shing lo phyugs legs/ /mi phyugs zas gos longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod/ /ces rgya ma khri khang sger gyi pho lha gnam the dkar po la 'phrin 'chol gyi tshig 'di yang khri dpon rin po che dza sag dbang sdud dgra 'dul gyi bkas bskul ba bzhin sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos khri khang dpal 'byor 'khyil par sbyar ba dge/ //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ 'phrin las bskul tshig re smon lhun grub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
